Personality: Rodarac, a prominent figure of the Scordisci, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Rodarac owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Scordisci. Historical Record: Lord of the Scordisci, descended from the Celts who returned from the raid on Delphi and settled on the Danube. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
